tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: satisfactory completed as a prime contractor at least one similar work of value not less than Rs.2.25 Lakhs. Work done certificate from the concerned authority of Govt or Semi Govt / ULBs /State or central Govt undertakings departments in Last Three Years 2023-24 to 2025-26
The bidder should have submit the GST in Registration certificate
The tenderer or firm should have Registered with the Concerned Statutory Authorities Tenderer needs to submit firm registration certificate from the competent authority
The tenderer/firm must have achieved in, at least any one financial years a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs. 4.5 lakhs in last 3 years. 2023-24 to 2025-26
